title: FTFN v0.3.1 — Evidence in public context
summary: A 54-route expansion that turns the operating cycle, additional place systems, named cases and cross-system analysis into bounded public reading surfaces.
publication_boundaries: No future Phase 60 gate is operated before its scheduled date, and no missing receipt or outcome is inferred.
Every new page resolves existing Published evidence or an explicit scheduled operating contract; it creates no source fact, receipt, observation, outcome, score or ranking.
French and Spanish editions remain In Review and unrouteable until a qualified human reviewer approves terminology, claims and links.

phases.title: Evidence-to-publication activation
phases.content_goal: Publish a reader-facing evidence-cycle desk while preserving every dated decision and future scheduled gate.

phases.title: Local-system expansion
phases.content_goal: Add ten place-bound system portraits, expanding editorial local-system coverage from five to fifteen.

phases.title: Casebook expansion
phases.content_goal: Add sixteen named-asset and delivery casebooks, expanding the casebook shelf from eight to twenty-four.

phases.title: Comparative public reports
phases.content_goal: Publish four flagship reports that connect evidence across systems without creating causal findings or rankings.

phases.title: Accessible and international reading
phases.content_goal: Publish linear reading editions and five jurisdiction lenses while holding French and Spanish translations for qualified human review.

evidence_cycle.publication_boundary: Phase 60 publishes the operating contract and schedule, not future evidence. A scheduled gate remains scheduled until its source is checked, a human decision is recorded, required surfaces are propagated, validation passes, and the change is committed to Git.
